handoff.text:
REJECT (agent-d1d3, independent). B2 is sound in its core and all its own checks pass on MY own build, but the exact case it exists to fix (narrow aside, 16.png) still shows a visible defect: the clamped menu's last option is CUT. Details below; every claim has a log path.

MY VERIFICATION (own build, own port 1846, pinned Node v22.23.3):
- npx vitest run src/components -> 87/87 passed (Popover.test 12/12). ui5-rev-d1d3/vitest-components.log
- npx vite build --outDir ui5-rev-d1d3/dist --emptyOutDir -> exit 0. ui5-rev-d1d3/build.log
- Playwright: popover-bounds + research + editor-toolbar + motion-u5/u6/u7 + split-view + sidebar-selection -> 74 passed / 0 failed; all 4 popover-bounds tests pass incl. the narrow aside and the toolbar baseline (<=1px vs ui5-b2/baseline-rects.json). ui5-rev-d1d3/acceptance.log
- Fail-first accepted: ui5-b2-review/fail-first-real.log fails at the bounds assertion (spec line 88) with the menu OPEN in results-pre/.../error-context.md -- failing for the right reason, not a timeout. Post-change pass confirmed on my build.
- My own light/dark x Plain/Color shots: ui5-rev-d1d3/shots/narrow-menu-{light,dark}-{plain,color}.png. The horizontal fix is real: the 16.png left-cut is gone, the menu sits inside the aside's left edge and the long label wraps.

DEFECT (narrow 260 only): Research -> check 'Use repeat citation rules' -> click 'Full citation again'. The menu gets inline maxHeight 78px while its scrollHeight is 115px, so the 2nd option 'In each section (one manuscript entry)' is cut 35px (option bottom 332 vs menu bottom 297) and the menu scrolls (clientHeight 76). Root cause: in measure(), popupHeight passed to placePopover is popup.scrollHeight read BEFORE the maxWidth clamp is applied, so it is the UN-WRAPPED height; after maxWidth=244 wraps the labels the content is 115px tall while maxHeight stays 78. Absent at 390 (labels do not wrap; last option bottom 294 <= menu bottom 297) and a REGRESSION: pre-B2 there was no maxWidth, so no wrap and no clip. Measurements: ui5-rev-d1d3/measure-clip-evidence.log (ASIDE260 'Full citation again' scrollH=115 clientH=76 maxHeight=78).

FIX: in measure(), apply maxWidth first, then (after a forced reflow) read popup.scrollHeight for the maxHeight clamp -- i.e. compute/apply width, re-measure height, then apply maxHeight; or call measure() twice after the width clamp. The menu then fits its wrapped content. ADD an assertion to tests/popover-bounds.spec.ts at the narrow width: last option bottom <= popup bottom + 1 (no cut / scrollHeight <= clientHeight + 1), so this cannot regress silently. Then re-run the B2 acceptance set and the narrow screenshots.

MINOR (not blocking by itself): at 260 the menu's right edge is 1441 vs the aside's right 1440 (1px past), inside the test's 1px tolerance.
ALSO: ui5-b2-review has no shots dir -- the plan's B2 visible-change screenshot step was not done. Please take and view them with the fix.
Unverified/unchanged: native WebKit (Chromium only).

WHAT CHANGED (src/components/Popover.tsx, measure()): measure the NATURAL width first (clear any clamp), apply the maxWidth clamp, then read the size again (forces a reflow) and clamp maxHeight to the menu's real, WRAPPED height; the flip/end decision uses the natural width so a later resize cannot measure the already-clamped width. Previously popupHeight came from scrollHeight read BEFORE the clamp, so a wrapped menu was taller than the maxHeight set and its last item was cut.
tests/popover-bounds.spec.ts: new assertion in the narrow-aside test and the default research test (incl. the Note form menu): last item bottom <= menu bottom + 1.

FAIL-FIRST (real source, pre-fix build ui5-rev-d1d3/dist): the new assertion FAILS with 'Full citation again last item is cut' at the narrow 260 aside; the other 3 popover-bounds tests pass. Log ui5-b2/d1d3/failfirst-newassert.log (EXIT 1).

The 1 failure is the KNOWN pre-existing split-view.spec.ts:155 flake: rerun in isolation --repeat-each=5 -> 4 pass / 1 fail, failing at line 212 applying the Georgia font (a render race), NOT at menu placement (split155-isolation.log).
- all 4 popover-bounds tests pass incl. the narrow aside and the unchanged toolbar baseline.

NUMERIC PROOF (projected against my fixed build): narrow 'Full citation again' -> scrollH 115 == clientH 113 (+2 px border), last item bottom 331.8 <= menu bottom 334.5 (was: maxHeight 78 vs scrollH 115, last item bottom 332 vs menu bottom 297 -- cut 35 px). Overflow probe: ui5-b2/d1d3/overflow.log.

SCREENSHOTS (taken AND viewed, light/dark x Plain/Color): ui5-b2/d1d3/shots/narrow-menu-*.png, narrow-aside-*.png, toolbar-*.png. The narrow menu now shows BOTH options fully; the long label wraps.

DESIGN SYSTEM: kept .popover[data-bounded]{overflow-wrap:anywhere}. For D1: a bounded menu wraps instead of sizing to content (design-system.md:63 'size to their content'), a deliberate deviation the plan asked for.

KNOWN 1 px (not fixed; low severity; plan-specified formula): at the narrow 260 aside the start-aligned menu's right edge is 1441 vs the aside's 1440, so the aside has 1 px of horizontal scrollable overflow (aside scrollWidth 260 vs clientWidth 259). Cause: maxWidth = boundary.width - 16 is a symmetric inset, but the menu's left sits at the trigger (17 px from the boundary's left here), so the clamp can exceed the room to the right by the trigger offset beyond 8 px. Fixing exactly would change placePopover's documented interface and its unit expectations (390-16/270-16/174-16), so I left the formula as the plan states; the acceptance tolerance is 1 px.
